## Daily tasks

Use your Compass to find your way. [Read its definition](../reference/glossary.md#compass), or explore the
[planned route](../growth/next-journey.md).

```checklist daily
Visit the bank
- [ ] Prepare for your next journey
```

## Weekly tasks

Make a little time for the things you want to return to.

```checklist weekly
Review your goals
Meet your party
```
